page_title: PAR 0-1 LEC | Parma v Lecce 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90+6' A corner kick by Parma is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
90+5' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' Parma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' Lameck Banda (Lecce) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
90+1' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Lecce! Play can continue.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.

90' Play continues despite the shouts by some Lecce players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Daniele Doveri interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
88' Substitution. Medon Berisha is replaced by Corrie Ndaba (Lecce).
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) for Lassana Coulibaly.
87' Lecce fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
87' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nahuel Estevez (Parma) replaces Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
84' Here is a change. Mathias Lovik is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Milan Djuric (Parma).
84' Lecce are ruled offside.
83' 14:14 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
82' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.
81' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) launches a cross from the corner, but Wladimiro Falcone is alert to thwart the effort.

81' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
79' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Doveri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
77' A clever short pass gives Patrick Cutrone (Parma) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
76' Today's match ends for Nikola Stulic who will be replaced by Francesco Camarda (Lecce).
73' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

70' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lecce are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
70' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) commits a rough foul. Daniele Doveri stops the game and makes a call.
68' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Riccardo Sottil and he is replaced by Lameck Banda (Lecce).
67' Carlos Cuesta decides to make a substitution. Oliver Sorensen (Parma) will be replaced by Adrian Benedyczak.
64' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
64' The resulting corner from Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. Lecce force their opponents to concede a corner.

64' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lecce are going to take it.
62' Shots on target – 1:3.
62' Medon Berisha (Lecce) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
61' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
60' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle and it's Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

54' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
53' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
52' My Gran could have done better! Patrick Cutrone (Parma) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
51' Wonderful movement by Parma. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
50' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Carlos Cuesta makes a switch. Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is coming on in place of Sascha Britschgi at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Parma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
42' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and blazes his shot high over the crossbar!
42' It seemed like Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
41' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
38' 0 - 1 Goal! Antonino Gallo tees up Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
37' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
35' Looks like Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
33' Lecce fail to score from a corner as Zion Suzuki (Parma) leaps to collect the ball.
31' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
31' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 2:3.
30' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
29' A cross from a corner kick by Lecce is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
28' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Lecce have a corner.
28' It's a weak, uncertain finish and easy for the goalkeeper. Patrick Cutrone (Parma) sends in a volley from just outside the box that goes a few yards wide of the left post.
26' Problems for Carlos Cuesta as Emanuele Valeri is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Mathias Lovik (Parma) replaces him.
24' A pass by Sascha Britschgi (Parma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

23' Parma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
18' It looks like Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Doveri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
16' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
15' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
14' Foul! Nikola Stulic (Lecce) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
13' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
11' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
10' A corner kick by Lecce is thwarted by the well prepared Zion Suzuki (Parma).
10' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lecce.
9' Daniele Doveri blows the whistle, Sascha Britschgi (Parma) is penalised for a foul. Lecce have a free kick.
8' The ball is cleared after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
4' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.

3' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball has crossed the sideline. Parma are taking a throw-in.
2' Parma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lecce will kick the game off.
Daniele Doveri was nominated as the referee for this game.
